title: CaptureCreateRequest
description: POST /v1/captures with an owner-scoped Idempotency-Key creates one capture investigation. Replays return the original open, empty session. Same key with a different chunk duration conflicts.

chunk_duration_ms.description: Nominal chunk duration, default 10000; server accepts 1000 through 30000 inclusive.
